final: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT AVG(m.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(m.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(m.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM invoice_metrics m CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE m.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio
